about: What the opening shows while the President speaks (owner, Oct 14 and Oct 27, 2026). The address plays over the director's sequence of stages (src/director/opening-sequence.ts): each stage opens on its own picture, where the people it points out stand. A sentence about a figure the town has (jobs, wages, prices, crime) cuts to the town's own employer of a kind listed under 'cutaways', pictured by that organization's own record (orgPlace) with the people who work there; a town with no such employer, or one nobody works at, keeps the address on its stage. '@visited-capitol' is the capitol of the state a place line names, 'capitol' the player's own state's, '@home' the player's home. The President speaks from the podium where the picture has one, in the lectern pose. SG-PLAY-opening-venue-has-no-inauguration-record: an inauguration is staged at the House rostrum (the one national picture with a podium and seats behind it) until the inauguration record carries its venue and the Capitol steps have a podium.
